body.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), if \(b=0\), then \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,s^2)\); for every \(u\ge0\), \(q_{*,\alpha}(u,0)=\sqrt u\inf\{t\ge0:\Pr(|\varepsilon|\le t)\ge1-\alpha\}\), so the envelope interval reduces to the standard conservative Neyman Gaussian form.
body.justification: This sanity reduction verifies that the new design-specific law disappears when outcomes have no linear covariate loading.
body.gap: The reduction is known under complete and uniform rerandomization, but it must be recovered from the stopped PSRR law rather than assumed.
body.consumer: The result provides a diagnostic special case and connects the proposed critical value to familiar design-based Wald inference.
